command.kubejs.item_list.parts.name: Part list of %s
command.kubejs.item_list.parts.lore: Contained every part of the material
material.kubejs.soil.flavor: Totally natural material! May get your hands dirty.
material.kubejs.soil.encyclopedia: The tool has a chance of level*20% to drop durability points by (1~3)*level every tick
material.kubejs.brick.encyclopedia: Damage get multiplied when falling. Multiplier is 1.5 at level 1, and increase 0.25 each level. Consumes 25% of remaining durability, at least 10 points
material.kubejs.coal.encyclopedia: Attack an enemy can set your tool on fire. During this time, tool will continuously lose its durability points, and set fire to other enemies as you attack
material.kubejs.lapis_lazuli.flavor: Keep mining! How do you know whether the block behind there is a stone or hidden treasures!
material.kubejs.lapis_lazuli.encyclopedi: When mining blocks, there is a chance to turn the block behind it into ores. Probability reduces and reach 0 at last
material.tconstruct.glass.encyclopedia: While attacking, if damage is greater than 5 points, then it is possible to deal damage to enemies in 3×3×3 area. Sum of the damage dealt is equal to the damage to the direct damage
material.kubejs.andesite_alloy.encyclope: The hitbox is a cube with edges that increase by 0.5 blocks per level. Entities in the hitbox take 50% of the damage you deal to the direct target
modifier.kubejs.incompact.flavor: Wash your hands after using the tool!
modifier.kubejs.incompact.description: Durability drops even when you are not using it
modifier.kubejs.uncertain.description: What if there's one more ore behind
modifier.kubejs.igniting.description: Conveys fire from one enemy to another
modifier.kubejs.glass_shard.description: Attack may cost more durability points. When this happens, enemies near the direct target will be hurt
modifier.kubejs.relaying.description: Hits enemies that are slightly behind the target when attacking
